_meta.description: Illustrative target-account seed list for Tesla Semi Benelux territory planning. Fleet/route/sustainability fields are public-domain estimates for prioritization only — verify with the account before outreach.
_meta.scoring_notes: Scores are 0-3 unless noted. depot_charging_feasible and regional_share favour duty-cycle fit (Semi range 800km covers most Benelux regional/depot-return routes). sustainability_signal proxies budget/mandate for ZE transition. fleet_scale proxies deal size.

accounts.name: PostNL
accounts.notes: National parcel network with hub-and-spoke depots; public net-zero 2030 logistics commitment.

accounts.name: DHL Parcel Netherlands
accounts.notes: DPDHL Group has a published EV-conversion programme for line-haul and last-mile fleets.

accounts.name: DPD Netherlands
accounts.notes: DPDgroup ZE city-logistics commitments; regional hub network suits depot charging.

accounts.name: Bol.com Logistics
accounts.notes: Large fulfilment centre with high-frequency regional shuttle runs to sort hubs.

accounts.name: Picnic
accounts.notes: Already operates electric last-mile fleet from regional fulfilment centres; strong EV-first culture, good reference customer.

accounts.name: Albert Heijn (Ahold Delhaize)
accounts.notes: Ahold Delhaize group-wide ZE transport ambitions; DC-to-store routes are classic regional return-to-base.

accounts.name: Jumbo Supermarkten
accounts.notes: Centralised DC network in Brabant/Gelderland; store-delivery routes well within 800km range.

accounts.name: Heineken Netherlands
accounts.notes: Brew Better World programme targets logistics emissions; depot-based distribution from main brewery.

accounts.name: Vos Logistics
accounts.notes: One of NL's largest haulage fleets; mixed regional/long-haul, good candidate for a phased pilot on regional lanes.

accounts.name: Simon Loos
accounts.notes: Has piloted electric/alternative-fuel trucks for retail distribution; flower/food cold-chain regional routes.

accounts.name: Den Hartogh Logistics
accounts.notes: Chemical/bulk transport around the Rotterdam/Antwerp port cluster; shorter port-to-plant lanes are good fit candidates.

accounts.name: Jan de Rijk Logistics
accounts.notes: Cross-border automotive/temperature-controlled freight; central depot near BE border.

accounts.name: Nabuurs
accounts.notes: Regional distribution for retail chains; own yard/depot in Gendt suitable for charger install.

accounts.name: DSV Solutions Netherlands
accounts.notes: Large 3PL with multiple Benelux warehouses; good multi-site rollout candidate after a single-site pilot.

accounts.name: Kuehne+Nagel Netherlands
accounts.notes: Group-level Net Zero Carbon programme; Benelux hub footprint around Rotterdam/Venlo.

accounts.name: Rotra
accounts.notes: Mid-size retail/e-commerce carrier with regional Brabant operations.

accounts.name: Van den Bosch Transporten
accounts.notes: International bulk powder/granulate transport; longer-haul lanes, better suited to a later phase.

accounts.name: Wijffels Transport
accounts.notes: Temperature-controlled fresh produce; regional NL/BE/DE lanes from a single depot.

accounts.name: Peter Appel Transport
accounts.notes: Regional retail distribution carrier, central NL location.

accounts.name: GVT Group of Logistics
accounts.notes: FMCG/retail distribution group based in Brabant.

accounts.name: Schenk Tanktransport
accounts.notes: Specialist tank transport; lower near-term fit due to ADR/equipment constraints.

accounts.name: Rhenus Logistics Netherlands
accounts.notes: Rhenus Group has multiple Benelux warehouse/distribution sites along the A15/A2 corridor.

accounts.name: Bakker Logistiek
accounts.notes: Major fresh/frozen food logistics provider with depot-based regional store-delivery routes.

accounts.name: Coop Netherlands Distribution
accounts.notes: Smaller grocery chain with a single central DC; compact regional route set.

accounts.name: Colruyt Group
accounts.notes: Publicly piloting hydrogen and electric heavy trucks for DC-to-store distribution; strong sustainability mandate and own depot infrastructure.

accounts.name: Delhaize Belgium
accounts.notes: Part of Ahold Delhaize group ZE logistics ambitions; central DC near Brussels.

accounts.name: Katoen Natie
accounts.notes: Large logistics group around Antwerp port; shorter port-to-plant shuttle lanes are the best initial fit.

accounts.name: H.Essers
accounts.notes: Large family-owned logistics group; has trialled alternative-fuel trucks and operates substantial owned-depot infrastructure (Genk, Lummen).

accounts.name: Van Moer Logistics
accounts.notes: Antwerp-area port and intermodal haulage; short shuttle lanes around the port complex.

accounts.name: Ninatrans
accounts.notes: Mid-size Flemish carrier; regional BE/NL/DE lanes.

accounts.name: Transport Vermeulen
accounts.notes: Flemish regional carrier, single-depot operation.

accounts.name: Stas Group
accounts.notes: Specialist food/livestock transport, longer cross-border lanes more common.

accounts.name: Group Heylen
accounts.notes: Mid-size Flemish logistics group with regional and international operations.

accounts.name: Kuehne+Nagel Luxembourg
accounts.notes: Small Luxembourg hub; group-level Net Zero programme applies.

accounts.name: CFL Multimodal
accounts.notes: State-backed intermodal terminal operator; road-leg drayage around the Bettembourg terminal is a regional fit.
